Monitor multiple jobs and record completed ones

Source: R/mono.R
monitor_jobs.Rd

Polls every poll_interval seconds until each submitted job has finished, then records its completion in the run store with record_completion(). A job with a job ID has finished when it is no longer in the queue; a job run by the local runners monolix.sh, pkanalix.sh or simulx.sh has finished already; any other job without a job ID has finished when one of its project type's result files (summary.txt for Monolix) exists in the output directory saved in its run.json. Runs whose submission failed are skipped. A run whose completion cannot be recorded gives a warning naming it, and the other runs are still monitored and recorded.

Usage

monitor_jobs(
  path,
  run_id,
  run_dir,
  job_id,
  cmd,
  store,
  poll_interval = 5,
  sq_failure_limit = 12
)

Arguments

path

Character vector. Paths to Monolix project files.

run_id

Character vector. Run IDs.

run_dir

Character vector. Run folders in the store.

job_id

Integer vector. External job IDs (from job scheduler).

cmd

Character vector. The commands used for each job.

store

Character scalar. The run store directory (see default_store()).

poll_interval

Numeric. Seconds between polls.

sq_failure_limit

Integer. Consecutive sq failures after which runs with a job ID are no longer monitored.

Value

NULL (invisible). Called for side effects.

Details

The queue is read with sq once per poll. When sq fails, a warning is given and the jobs with a job ID count as still queued for that poll. After sq_failure_limit consecutive failures those runs are no longer monitored and are left unrecorded, for finalize_runs() to record once they finish.
